bullets.ai_gateway_security: Hardened a production AI agent gateway (OpenClaw) serving Claude Opus 4 inference, implementing LLM security controls against OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS threat models. Blocked prompt injection, excessive agency, and system prompt leakage across 6 deployed skills.
bullets.zero_trust: Zero publicly exposed ports. Built the entire network on Cloudflare Zero Trust tunnels with mTLS certificate authentication, routing all traffic through encrypted tunnels instead of opening firewall rules.
bullets.soar_automation: 16 automated security workflows running on n8n SOAR, handling everything from threat intel enrichment to credential rotation alerts. Cut manual triage time from 23 hours/week down to 4.
bullets.detection_engineering: Alert fatigue was killing the detection pipeline. Tuned Falco eBPF runtime rules from 200+ daily alerts down to 12 actionable ones, then wired Falcosidekick to push critical findings straight into Datadog dashboards.
bullets.iam_pam: Deployed Teleport for privileged access management with JIT access provisioning, session recording, and automatic expiration. Stood up Keycloak for RBAC across the stack. No more shared admin accounts.
bullets.cicd_security: Full shift-left pipeline with container security baked in. GitHub Actions runs Trivy scans, Semgrep SAST, Gitleaks secrets detection, and OPA policy checks on every PR. Cosign signs images, Syft generates SBOMs for supply chain security traceability.
bullets.iac_compliance: Entire infrastructure defined in 16 Terraform files managing 30+ resources across DigitalOcean and Cloudflare. Wrote 8 OPA/Rego policies that block non-compliant changes before they hit production.
bullets.grc_documentation: Authored 31 GRC documents from scratch: SSP with NIST 800-53 control mapping, POA&M tracking 47 findings, 10 security policies, 4 IR playbooks, risk assessment, and a tabletop exercise. Not templated. Every document references actual infrastructure evidence.

bullets.endpoint_security: Managed endpoint security and vulnerability management across 45+ devices with CrowdStrike Falcon, handling detection tuning, policy enforcement, and quarterly threat assessments for a multi-site retail operation.
bullets.network_segmentation: Inherited a flat network with zero segmentation. Split it into 4 VLANs isolating POS payment traffic, back-office systems, guest WiFi, and management. Lateral movement dropped to near zero.
bullets.siem_monitoring: Cut mean time to detect from 48 hours to under 4 by deploying Splunk log aggregation across all endpoints and network devices. Set up correlation rules that caught 3 credential stuffing attempts in the first month.
bullets.ad_hardening: AD was a mess when I took over. Enforced Group Policy baselines, killed stale accounts, locked down admin rights, and set up automated credential rotation. Audit findings went from 14 to 2.
bullets.incident_response: Ran incident response for everything from ransomware scares to POS skimmer investigations. Built a 6-step IR runbook that cut average containment time from 8 hours to 90 minutes.
bullets.automation_scripting: Wrote PowerShell scripts automating patch deployment, user provisioning, and compliance reporting. Saved roughly 12 hours/week on what used to be manual checkbox work.
bullets.vendor_management: Sole IT person for 3 locations. Managed vendor relationships, negotiated service contracts, handled the security budget, and kept everything running on a shoestring.

bullets.it_operations: Managed IT operations for a regional distribution company, overseeing network infrastructure, endpoint deployments, and help desk escalations across 2 warehouse locations.
bullets.incident_management: Resolved 150+ IT incidents over 2 years, maintaining a 97% first-contact resolution rate by building a knowledge base that the whole team actually used.
bullets.process_improvement: Nobody had documentation when I started. Created SOPs for onboarding, equipment provisioning, and incident escalation that survived after I left.
bullets.security_basics: First person to enforce basic security hygiene: MFA on admin accounts, automated patching schedule, and password policy enforcement across all endpoints.
